summary: Register a main-side listener for asynchronous renderer IPC messages.

target.notes: Requires an IPC runtime preserving channel routing, event objects, listener identity and message ordering.

caveats: event.reply must target the sending frame, while event.sender.send targets the sender WebContents main frame.
references: Electron IPC tutorial / Structured Clone semantics

tests.name: receive async message
tests.expected_behavior: listener runs for async renderer messages on ping with an IpcMainEvent and cloned arguments

tests.name: multiple listeners
tests.expected_behavior: both listeners remain registered in EventEmitter order
